## What We Do
We are New England's premier ice cream truck catering service. We provide premium ice cream trucks and vintage ice cream vans for events of all sizes. 

## Top Services & Occasions
- **Corporate Events & Office Parties:** Perfect for employee appreciation, job site resets, and company picnics.
- **Weddings:** A unique late-night dessert catering experience.
- **Birthday Parties & Family Reunions:** Creating nostalgic sweet memories for families.
- **Festivals & School Events:** Equipped to serve massive crowds quickly and efficiently.
